validation_scope: Deterministic local validation only; no model, provider, database, benchmark, server, or remote call.
self_hash_policy: validation_manifest.json excludes its own hash to avoid recursive self-reference; compute its transport hash after validation.

checks.check: Parse every JSON artifact with PowerShell ConvertFrom-Json.
Recompute SHA-256 for every evidence_manifest source and compare exactly.
Require unique evidence claim IDs and resolve every Cxx reference from synthesis, intent, and contract.
Require G11, G12, and G13 keys in implementation_contract.generation_mapping.
Require local tests, small_scale_gate, frozen_56_promotion_gate, runtime_invariants, fail_closed_rules, budgets, and telemetry sections.
Require meta draft to declare controller authorship and false Research Meta, Graph-target, implementation, and evaluation authorization flags.
Scan generated artifacts for credential-value patterns and private-key headers.
Confirm Git branch and HEAD and that the target directory is the only task-created Git path.

known_non_validation: No Research Meta schema validation was claimed because the controller-authored draft intentionally lacks packet-bound neutral selection sections.
No implementation, local implementation test suite, provider probe, small panel, or frozen 56-task evaluation was run.
No claim is made that the integrated mechanism reaches 40/56.
